name: Penguin Clash
summary: Penguin Clash is a 3-minute multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game played in a web browser on phones and computers. Teams of penguins meet in 1v1, 3v3 or 5v5 matches: players tap or click to move, tap an enemy to focus it and fire a single power, and win by destroying the enemy's Moon Beacon or by having the healthier beacon when time runs out. In the last minute the moon rises and beacons take double damage. Each fighter is one of 10,000 hand-drawn penguins, whose outfit sets its role (ten roles, such as Brawler, Rogue, Scout and Shieldbearer) and whose hat sets its power. Online matches start with real players, and bots fill any empty seats. The penguins are also an NFT collection on Base, but owning one is not needed to play.
